_comment: Tropical min-plus GEMM — 128×128×128 matrices, workgroup=(16,16,1), dispatch=(8,8,1) → 128×128 output. WARNING: the WGSL module declares TWO entry points (tropical_min_plus_gemm and tropical_spmv) and BOTH reuse @group(0) @binding(0..N) for distinct types (matA: storage f32 vs rowPtr: storage u32, etc.). WGSL permits duplicate binding decls only when each entry point statically uses a disjoint subset. With layout:'auto' the BGL is derived from the statically-used bindings of the SELECTED entry point, so only the 4 bindings consumed by tropical_min_plus_gemm (matA, matB, matC, gemmDims) are bound. If pipeline creation rejects the module due to declaration conflicts, the shader needs to be split into two files before bench-capture can target the SpMV variant. TropicalGemmDims = { m: u32, n: u32, k: u32, _pad: u32 } = 16 bytes — clean fit for uniform-u32-tuple.
section: Tropical (min-plus) matrix-matrix multiply — shortest-path / dynamic-programming kernel used by the tropical-algebra SNN bridge. Companion to paper-2-tropical-activation-10k.json (elementwise) and the SpMV variant in this same WGSL module (not benched here due to overlapping-binding declaration; see _comment).
